title: Zesty Velvety Portuguese Beans Stir-fry
description: A bright, low-carb stir-fry packed with bitter green beans, smoky paprika, and citrus zest, delivering a velvety texture and energetic kick.

ingredients.name: green beans
ingredients.notes: trimmed and cut into 2 cm pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and red onion, sautéing until fragrant and translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the green beans and sliced bay leaf, cooking for 5 minutes to start tenderizing.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika over the beans, stirring to coat evenly and release its aroma for 1 minute.
Pour in the lemon juice, add salt and pepper, and toss to combine, allowing the beans to steam in the citrusy liquid for 4 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, cover the skillet, and let the beans simmer until they reach a velvety texture, about 7 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf, then fold in the lemon zest and chopped parsley, stirring until the dish is bright and aromatic.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with extra lemon zest for a zesty finish.
